Definition: , including the oblique forms, as well as ἦς; ἦ; etc. the subjunctive of G1510; (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with G1487 and its compounds, as well as with other particles) be:--+ appear, are, (may, might, should) be, X have, is, + pass the flower of her age, should stand, were.
